question: A, B, C, D, E and F live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6. The product of floors on which F and D live is 15. E lives immediately above C .The sum of floors on which A and D live is 7. What is the sum of floors on which A and E live?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E and F live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6. 

1) The product of floors on which F and D live is 15. 

2) The sum of floors on which A and D live is 7.
